scope.carrier_scope: H20 is the decoded erasure carrier H5 tensor conjugate(H4); identification with a charged E8 current block requires a separate bridge.
scope.clock_scope: Covariance is only with individual elements of the diagonal native G31 product representation. The reviewed common-source files define the H20 lifts C_j tensor conjugate(u_j) of native events, but no H20 lift of the separate marked logical R was found. No commutation with a coherent source-word clock, P1/source-sigma clock bridge, or physical time unit is asserted.
scope.extra_menu_choice: The u_m are unitary elements of the represented source C*-algebra, not generally single original G31 words or primitive reflections. Declaring them elementary Kraus events is an additional source-event menu choice.
scope.factorizing_scope: Factorization follows, rather than being assumed, if complete logical nondisturbance Tr_4 Phi(X)=Tr_4 X is required for every joint X. Preservation only of erasure states rho tensor I4/4 does not imply it.

scope.record_algebra_scope: The sixteen projective Pauli record labels transform equivariantly on the represented block algebra A_joint=M4 directsum M5 directsum M20, where sector-dependent central phases cancel under adjoint action. This is not literal branch covariance on full End(H29), whose inter-sector coherences see those relative phases. Refining to sixty-four phased Pauli records would define a different record alphabet and cross-block channel.
scope.symmetry_scope: Pauli invariance alone gives a 16-dimensional fixed space in the full fourth tensor power. The five-dimensional code additionally uses Sym^4(V4).
